new_en:
LS (Left Stick) | Move | Character movement controls | 
RS (Right Stick) Left/Right | Change Leader | Tap left or right to instantly swap team member controls | 
Circle | Close-Range Attack | Punch/ kick to perform combo moves | 
Triangle | Ninjutsu | Draw the seal to use a hidden jutsu or secret technique (Secret Technique) | 
Square | Shuriken | Throw shuriken to attack from a distance | 
Cross | Jump | Jump or charge toward the enemy | 
L2 | Substitution Ninjutsu | Swap forms to dodge attacks (use dodge gauge) | 
R2 | Guard | Block incoming attacks | 
L1 | Support 1 | Summon support character #1 | 
R1 | Support 2 | Summon support character #2 | 
D-Pad | Use Battle Item (Ninja Tools) | Use item in 4 directions | 
Touch Pad | Menu | Open pause menu |
